<ix:exclude><p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#160;&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">The new tax track under the Amendment, which is applicable to the Israeli subsidiary, is the &#8220;Technological Preferred Enterprise&#8221;. A Technological Preferred Enterprise is an enterprise for which total consolidated revenues of its parent company and all subsidiaries are less than 10 billion New Israeli Shekel (&#8220;NIS&#8221;). A Technological Preferred Enterprise, as defined in the law, which is located in the center of Israel (where our Israeli subsidiary is currently located) is subject to tax at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c2145" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis-IntellectualPropertyMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">12</ix:nonFraction>% on profits deriving from IP (in development area A, the tax rate is <ix:nonFraction id="c2146" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassAxis-IntellectualPropertyMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember_StatementGeographicalAxis-DevelopmentAreaAMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">7.5</ix:nonFraction>%), subject to satisfaction of a number of conditions, including compliance with a minimal amount or ratio of annual Research and development expenditure and Research and development employees, as well as having at least 25% of annual income derived from exports. Any dividends distributed to "foreign companies", as defined in the law, deriving from income from the technological enterprises will be subject to tax at a rate of 4% if foreign entities hold at least 90% of the Company&#8217;s common stock.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">In light of the Company's decision not to distribute a dividend in the coming year, <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c2147">no</span> tax expenses were recognized in the tax year.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">The balance of accumulated income that has not yet been thawed as of December 31, 2024 is <ix:nonFraction id="c2148" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="ILS" name="us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsOfForeignSubsidiaries" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">118,512</ix:nonFraction> NIS (approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c2149" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsOfForeignSubsidiaries" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">32,496</ix:nonFraction>)</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">In addition, due to a lack of intention to distribute a dividend in a subsidiary that has imprisoned profits, the Company did <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c2150">not</span> recognize as of December 31, 2024 a deferred tax liability against recognition of deferred tax expenses.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">Income not eligible for Technological Preferred Enterprise is taxed at a regular rate, which was <ix:nonFraction id="c2151" contextRef="d_2022-01-01_2022-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2"><ix:nonFraction id="c2152" contextRef="d_2023-01-01_2023-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2"><ix:nonFraction id="c2153" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">23</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>% in 2022, 2023 and 2024.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Israeli subsidiary elected to compute taxable income in accordance with Income Tax Regulations (Rules for Accounting for Foreign Investors Companies and Certain Partnerships and Setting their Taxable Income), 1986. Accordingly, the taxable income or loss is calculated in U.S. dollars. Applying these regulations reduces the effect of the foreign exchange rate (of NIS against the U.S. dollar) on the Company&#8217;s Israeli taxable income.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of December 31, 2024, the open tax years, subject to review by the applicable taxing authorities for the Israeli subsidiary, are <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c2154">2020</span> and subsequent years.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;"><i>3. French Subsidiary</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">Since 2021, the Company&#8217;s French subsidiary is entitled to a tax benefit of <ix:nonFraction id="c2155" contextRef="d_2021-01-01_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFranceMember" unitRef="Pure" name="ceva:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationSpecificRevenuesUnderTheFrenchIpBoxRegime" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">10</ix:nonFraction>% applied to specific revenues under the French IP Box regime. The French IP Box regime applies to net income derived from the licensing, sublicensing or sale of several IP rights such as patents and copyrighted software, including royalty revenues. This elective regime requires a direct link between the income benefiting from the preferential treatment and the R&amp;D expenditures incurred and contributing to that income. Qualifying income may be taxed at a favorable <ix:nonFraction id="c2156" contextRef="d_2021-01-01_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFranceMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">10</ix:nonFraction>% CIT rate (plus social surtax, hence <ix:nonFraction id="c2157" contextRef="d_2021-01-01_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFranceMember" unitRef="Pure" name="ceva:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationPlusSocialSurtaxPercentTotal" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">10.3</ix:nonFraction>% in total).</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">Income not eligible for a tax benefit under the French IP Box regime is taxed at a regular rate, which was <ix:nonFraction id="c2158" contextRef="d_2022-01-01_2022-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFranceMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2"><ix:nonFraction id="c2159" contextRef="d_2023-01-01_2023-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFranceMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2"><ix:nonFraction id="c2160" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFranceMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">25</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>% in 2022, 2023 and 2024.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of December 31, 2024, the open tax years subject to review by the applicable taxing authorities for the French subsidiary are <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c2161">2022</span> and subsequent years.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;"><i>e. Deferred taxes on income:</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Changes in valuation allowances on deferred tax assets result from management's assessment of the Company's ability to utilize certain future tax deductions, operating losses and tax credit carryforwards prior to expiration. Valuation allowances were recorded to reduce deferred tax assets to an amount that will, more likely than not, be realized in the future.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">During the year ended December 31, 2023, the Company concluded that, based on its evaluation of available evidence, it was no longer more likely than not that certain deferred tax assets were recoverable. As a result, the Company recorded a valuation allowance of $<ix:nonFraction id="c2258" contextRef="i_2022-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-IsraelTaxAuthorityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DeferredTaxAssetsValuationAllowance" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">4,429</ix:nonFraction> for the year ended December 31 2023 against its deferred tax assets.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of December 31, 2024, the Company&#8217;s undistributed earnings from non-U.S. subsidiaries are intended to be indefinitely reinvested in non-U.S. operations, and therefore no U.S. deferred taxes liabilities have been recorded.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:9pt;">As of both December 31, 2023 and 2024, there were $<ix:nonFraction id="c2265" contextRef="i_2023-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsThatWouldImpactEffectiveTaxRate" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3"><ix:nonFraction id="c2266" contextRef="i_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsThatWouldImpactEffectiveTaxRate" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">462</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> of unrecognized tax benefits that if recognized would affect the annual effective tax rate. The Company accrued interest in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c2267" contextRef="d_2024-12-31_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesExpense" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">85</ix:nonFraction> relating to unrecognized tax benefits in its provision for income taxes during the year ended December 31, 2024. The Company did <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c2268"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c2269">not</span></span> accrue penalties relating to unrecognized tax benefits in its provision for income taxes during the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024 because such penalties did not have a material impact on the Company&#8217;s financial statements.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:9pt;">The Company believes that an adequate provision has been made for any adjustments that may result from tax examinations. However, the outcome of tax audits cannot be predicted with certainty. If any issues addressed in the Company's tax audits are resolved in a manner not consistent with management's expectations, the Company could be required to adjust its provision for income taxes in the period such resolution occurs. The Company does not expect uncertain tax positions to change significantly over the next 12 months, except in the case of settlements with tax authorities, the likelihood and timing of which are difficult to estimate.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;"><i>g. Tax loss carryforwards:</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of December 31, 2024, Ceva and its subsidiaries had <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c2270">no</span> remaining net operating loss carryforwards for federal income tax purposes. As of December 31, 2024, Ceva and its subsidiaries had net operating loss carryforwards for various state income tax purposes of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c2271" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-StateAndLocalJurisdictionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">2,963</ix:nonFraction> which are available to offset taxable income. <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of December 31, 2024, Ceva&#8217;s Irish subsidiary had foreign operating losses of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c2272" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_IncomeTaxAuthorityAxis-ForeignCountryMember_IncomeTaxAuthorityNameAxis-RevenueCommissionersIrelandMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">48,601</ix:nonFraction>, which are available to offset future taxable income indefinitely.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;"><i>h</i>. <i>Tax returns</i>:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Ceva files income tax returns in the U.S. federal jurisdiction and various state and local jurisdictions. <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">c. Royalties:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Company participated in programs sponsored by the Israeli government for the support of research and development activities. Through December&#160;31, 2024, the Company had obtained grants from the IIA for certain of the Company&#8217;s research and development projects. The Company is obligated to pay royalties to the IIA, amounting to <ix:nonFraction id="c2412" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-IIAMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="Pure" name="ceva:PercentageOfRoyaltyExpense" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">3</ix:nonFraction>%-<ix:nonFraction id="c2413" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-IIAMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="Pure" name="ceva:PercentageOfRoyaltyExpense" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">3.5</ix:nonFraction>% of the sales of the products and other related revenues (based on the dollar) generated from such projects, up to <ix:nonFraction id="c2414" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-IIAMember" unitRef="Pure" name="ceva:RoyaltyPaymentPercentageAsPercentageOfGrantReceived" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the grants received. Royalty payment obligations also bear interest at the LIBOR rate. The obligation to pay these royalties is contingent on actual sales of the products and in the absence of such sales, no payment is required.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Royalty expenses relating to the IIA grants included in cost of revenues for the years ended December&#160;31, 2022, 2023 and 2024 amounted to $<ix:nonFraction id="c2415" contextRef="d_2022-01-01_2022-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-IIAMember_IncomeStatementLocationAxis-CostOfRevenuesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">1,221</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction id="c2416" contextRef="d_2023-01-01_2023-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-IIAMember_IncomeStatementLocationAxis-CostOfRevenuesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-4">1,010</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction id="c2417" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-IIAMember_IncomeStatementLocationAxis-CostOfRevenuesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RoyaltyExpense" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-4">1,580</ix:nonFraction>, respectively. As of December&#160;31, 2024, the aggregate contingent liability to the IIA (including interest) amounted to $<ix:nonFraction id="c2418" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-IIAMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:AccruedRoyaltiesCurrent" scale="3" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">28,468</ix:nonFraction>.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">KNOW ALL MEN BY THESE PRESENTS, that each person whose signature appears below constitutes and appoints Amir Panush and Yaniv Arieli or either of them, his true and lawful attorneys-in-fact and agents, with full power of substitution and re-substitution, for him and in his name, place and stead, in any and all capacities to sign any and all amendments to this Annual Report on Form&#160;10&#8209;K, and to file the same, with all exhibits thereto and other documents in connection therewith, with the SEC, granting unto said attorneys-in-fact and agents, and each of them, full power and authority to do and perform each and every act and thing requisite and necessary to be done in connection therewith, as fully to all intents and purposes as he might or could do in person, hereby ratifying and confirming all that said attorneys-in-fact and agents, or either of them, or their or his substitutes or substitute, may lawfully do or cause to be done by virtue hereof.</p>
